intended_use: Evaluating entity span detection and message risk triage for the LEAKGUARD security intelligence console. Contains synthetic data only.
privacy_notice: All personal names, emails, cards, Aadhaar, PAN, and phone numbers are synthetically generated with test ranges and RFC domains. Zero real personal data.
source: Author-written template library rendered via Faker (en_IN, en_US) and mathematical checksum generators
transformation_steps: 1. Author writes 157 structured templates across 15 semantic families.
2. SyntheticValueFactory generates realistic values using Faker (en_IN, en_US) and algorithmic checksums (Verhoeff for Aadhaar, Luhn for Cards, Mod-97 for IBAN).
3. Segments are rendered with dynamic offset accumulation to capture exact [start, end) character spans.
4. Immediate per-row schema and offset alignment validation.
5. Deterministic shuffling and group splitting by family_id (60% train, 20% val, 20% test).
6. Cross-split exact duplicate hash scan and n-gram Jaccard near-duplicate verification.
7. Extraction of 200-row representative balanced sample for git tracking.
